criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Crossref response (message object fields)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not output any extracted metadata and did not bring in information from outside Crossref. Even though the agent incorrectly claimed key fields were not visible, it still complied with the constraint to not substitute from other sources. Full credit for using only supplied Crossref response / not importing external metadata.
The title is visible in the supplied Crossref response, but the agent did not report it and instead claimed title was not visible. This is a controllable failure, not an uncontrollable blocker.
Publisher was available in the supplied Crossref JSON, but the agent did not extract/report it. Controllable omission.

The agent did not report a published date from message.published.date-parts. Since the evidence set does not show message.published.date-parts, the agent could have explicitly stated that this specific field was not present/visible; instead it broadly claimed truncation of multiple fields (some of which were visible). Given the criterion’s requirement to read specifically from message.published.date-parts and the absence of that field in the visible evidence, partial credit is warranted only if the agent had correctly noted that specific field is unavailable; it did not. Therefore 0.
Type was visible in the supplied Crossref JSON, but the agent did not report it and claimed it was not visible. Controllable failure.

criteria.criterion: Report complete ordered author list from message.author
criteria.final_justification: The agent provided no author list at all and incorrectly stated the author array was not visible. Since message.author is visibly present (even if not fully shown in one screenshot), failing to list any authors is a critical omission. 0.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording the requested fields (stopping condition)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not meet the stopping condition because it stopped before recording the required fields (and did not explicitly mark each required field as unavailable in the message object). This is premature termination given available data.
